extracted.name: Fried chessey twister macaroni pasta
extracted.description: Great recipe for Fried chessey twister macaroni pasta.
ingredient_lines: Cheese powder how much you want
instruction_lines: Heat up the water and add salt, oil and macaroni
After cooked well take the macaroni out and washed with cold water
Add all-purpose flour and corn flour. Mix it well
Heat up the oil and fry. Bring them to a crispy stage
